pages.title: Maledictus
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Frosted Prison: Maledictus's cursium and its armour, the soul render, the annihilator, the cursed bow and the wrath of the desert, the draugr's black steel, and the frosted halls.$(br2)$(thing)Relics$(n), ring 11.$(br)$(thing)56 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After The Leviathan.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill Maledictus$(n)$(br2)Pays 10 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
